reviews.review_title: Cozy Space Salvage After a Long Day
reviews.review_description:
What can an Echo VR enthusiast, do someone who once played in a top team when the game is shutting down? Make a game with the exact same movement style as Echo VR! It feels great to be back in zero gravity. 

After a busy day, you can go into a silent space with relaxing cosmic music to clean up all the wrecks as a contractor for SARIS Industries. Finish your weekly contracts for a little cashout and upgrades, and find better sectors to explore the unknown! ;-)) 

A Pre-Early Access weekend tester.

developer_response.body: Thank you for the review, and i totally agree, i love just being able to float around in space (supposedly doing my day job) and just throwing junk around.

reviews.review_description:
This game is a cool concept, but right now it is very buggy, not very visually appealing, and just feels like a demo rather than a game that costs 20 dollars.
To be honest, do NOT spend money on this right now, maybe in the future once it has a pc release. 
The textures are bad, things just have no collision for some reason, height seems to be glitched, hands move unnaturally.
I don't know why the dev didn't just come out with a pcvr release first, it's much easier to develop without having to restrict yourself with standalones crappy graphics.

developer_response.body:
Thanks for the review; the detail helps, and I appreciate the honesty.

Physics is what I'm working on right now. The collision problems and the hand
movement are both in the upcoming v1.4.2 patch, and I'm sorry for the issues its been causing. As a one-man team, I've been pretty spread out over everything; it's been difficult to make sure everything works perfectly.

Height and arm length are adjustable in the settings menu under Avatar, worth
setting those first if you haven't already. If your height is still off after that then it's a bug, and I'd like to hear about it. The Discord link on the store page is the fastest way
to reach me. Same goes for the textures: what is "bad" about them/you would like to see fixed, as currently I don't know what to fix about them.

A PC version is possible later, but Quest standalone is what DustCrow is built
for, and none of the issues you specified would have made a difference if it was PC or Quest standalone.

If it isn't worth the price as it stands, then by all means refund it, that's a fair call on
something that just went into early access. I'd hope you'd give it another try in future!

reviews.review_description:
DUSTCROW is a game and a VR experience for all ages. I was so honoured to be part of the early play tests, and I'm so proud of how Rad, the solo developer brought the game from a idea into existence for us all to experience. 

DUSTCROW is not supposed to be a fast action game, however you'll find yourself spending many hours exploring, figuring our various ways to extract as much material as posible, studying the economy in order to earn the most amount of cash and completing various missions. 

Also, if you sign up to the Patreon, you can have your own message in game on any particular piece of space debris that will float in space waiting to be discovered by you the player.

If you want a break from most conventional VR games and experiences, I highly recommends this game for you.

developer_response.body: Thank you so much for your review. I've put my heart and soul into developing something i really hope everyone can enjoy. I look forward to where this game will be in a year's time!

reviews.review_description: I’ve been here since the start and loved the idea of the game and the whole concept of space exploration and finding interesting stuff in space I love the game and the whole idea but unfortunately there is only one problem and it’s the grabbing and touching physics I don’t know if it’s only me but whenever I try and grab something it doesn’t work or it’s in the completely wrong place sometimes when I’m in 0g and I fly at a wall slowly to try and grab on to it I just slide across it. I really do want to play this game but I am really finding it hard to when I can’t grasp things properly as the whole game resolves around grabbing and moving things other than that though there are no problems I have encountered

developer_response.body: Thank you for your review and im glad youre enjoying the game despite the issues. im working hard to resolve these issues currently, if possible, would you be able to outline a bit more where specifically and with what you were unable to grab onto etc, if you have the ability to, could you either join the Discord or sent the support email outlining the specifics of the issues you encountered?

reviews.review_description: As to be expected of a new game, it is extremely buggy to the point where I find it unplayable, there is also a severe lack of any real tutorial, couldn't even get past the first mission because I didnt know what to do, plus I kept having bugs that caused the tools to disappear or I would just phase through objects, definitely needs a lot of work but I see the potential, either that or im just being a total idiot haha, I normally play fighting games so this genre is a bit foreign to me

developer_response.body:
You're not being an idiot, if you got stuck on the first mission, that's on me for not making it clear enough.

There are voice lines and waypoint markers meant to walk you through it, so
either they aren't currently working for you, or they aren't clear enough.

The tools vanishing is the exact bug I'm working on right now, and phasing
through objects is part of the same physics problem im working hard to fix. Both should be gone shortly in the v1.4.2 patch today.

If you have any other issues, come say hi on the Discord (link on the store page) and I'll be glad to help. And coming at it from fighting games is useful, if it doesn't make sense to someone new to the genre then that's important for me to try and fix!

Would you be able to submit a bug report in the discord explaining how you managed todo this
